facts.fact: 酒吧醒来发现旁边不是出租车司机，窘迫想坐直
facts.anchor: Yna squeaked, her voice an octave higher than usual.

facts.fact: 她想叫真出租，Kai 抓手臂说送她回家，交钥匙给 Thomas 开回车
facts.anchor: Kai interrupted gently, his grip on her arm warm and unyielding.

facts.fact: 车里她说多数人会叫 Uber 回顶层，他答我不是大多数人
facts.anchor: Kai glanced at her in the rearview mirror, his profile silhouetted

facts.fact: 到家他从手套箱拿亚麻手帕擦她嘴角，低语她真是一团糟
facts.anchor: Kai reached into the glove compartment, retrieved a clean linen handkerchief

facts.fact: 次晨 6:30 闹钟如炮弹，7:15 下楼装火鸡三明治
14 岁 Elizabeth 进厨房摇头叹气你完全没救了，坐下涂面包
facts.anchor: Elizabeth let out a long, heavy sigh, shaking her head.

facts.fact: 9:00 到 40 楼，Kai 站她桌旁放冰水/两片布洛芬/热姜柠茶
facts.anchor: Standing over her desk in an impeccably tailored charcoal suit was Kai Rhodes.

facts.fact: 【转折】她记起昨夜醉后让 Kai 抱上楼、称我的黑王子并主动吻唇，14 岁 Elizabeth 全程在场
facts.anchor: before planting a loud, unmistakably deliberate kiss straight onto his lips.
